Hi Magda,

 

I seem to have been missed from the initial email to set up the Avicenna account, so was only made aware on Friday when Paul cc’d me – hence just getting to this today 😊

 

I have downloaded the app and created account as participant9 – it’s asking for a validation code, if you could let me know this.

 

I’ve also set up a researcher account with Fiona.caryl@glasgow.ac.uk if you could add me to project 3950.

 

Best wishes,

Fi

 

From: Paul Mccrorie <Paul.McCrorie@glasgow.ac.uk>
Sent: 13 September 2024 13:31

Cc: Fiona Caryl <Fiona.Caryl@glasgow.ac.uk>
Subject: Re: Avicenna's current app testing

 

Hi Magda

 

Not had the easiest time setting up on my phone. Lot's of buggy error messages when trying to sign up, especially when entering the Study ID. It also said that an account for participant3 had already signed up (i haven't) so I've used participant10 instead. Within the instructions to setup on iPhone it needs me to validate the email address - is this for you to do Magda? It also needs me to turn on background app refresh in settings. When I go to settings it is on but greyed out and I can't change it. The app doesn't seem to recognise I have it switched on though.

 

Otherwise I'm not too sure if it has started recording my location data or not. Nothing to tell me it has.

 

Anything else I need to do?

 

Thanks,

 

Paul

From: Borkowska, Magda <m.borkowska@essex.ac.uk>
Sent: Tuesday, September 10, 2024 11:32

Subject: Avicenna's current app testing

 

Hi Paul, hi Fi

Hope you’re well. As promised here are the instructions of how to create participant and researcher account for the current Avicenna app.

If you have troubles with setting app your accounts please contact sara@avicennaresearch.com and CC me.

Once you’ve created your researcher account please let me know and I’ll add you to the platform.

All best

Magda

*****************************************************************************

To test your sample study from the participant's perspective, please follow the instructions below:

  1. Install the Avicenna mobile application on your smartphone. You can find the iOS app here and the Android app here.
  1. Launch the app and sign up as a new participant. Please note that you need to use the provided email address(es) as your username but you can choose your own password.
  1. When you are asked to enter the study registration code, enter the provided Study ID and follow the instructions. Check this document to learn more about this registration process.

- Study ID: 3950

- Participants’ usernames:

  • participant1@essex.ac.uk Magda
  • participant2@essex.ac.uk Giulia
  • participant3@essex.ac.uk Paul Mc
  • participant4@essex.ac.uk Annette
  • participant5@essex.ac.uk Jon
  • participant6@essex.ac.uk Jim
  • participant7@essex.ac.uk Sam
  • participant8@essex.ac.uk Owen
  • participant9@essex.ac.uk Fi C
  • participant10@essex.ac.uk

Moreover, if you and your team members would like to also try the researcher's side of our platform, you can create a researcher account here using the email addresses you shared with me earlier. Once done, please let me know so that I can add you as researchers to Study ID: 3950. As researchers, you will be able to access the sample study in your researcher dashboard.

Alternatively, if you prefer to join the study as participants using your organizational email addresses, please inform me so that I can invite the email addresses you shared before as participants.

If you have any questions in the meantime, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
